name: Cobalt Grid
description: Two-color trend-report editorial system on warm cream paper with electric cobalt ink and a permanent graph-paper grid behind every slide. Newsreader serif at weight 400 for all display, Hanken Grotesk for all body and labels, DM Mono for all chrome. The pixel-glitch vertical scanline column and QR-style 8x8 mosaics are the signature decorative patches. Pixel-stack bar charts render data as grid-unit cells. Top and bottom 1.5px cobalt hairlines frame every slide. Strictly two-color: cream + cobalt only.
descriptionZh: 暖奶油色纸 + 电光钴蓝墨水的双色趋势报告编辑系统。每页幻灯片后均有永久性方格纸网格。Newsreader 衬线字重 400 用于展示，Hanken Grotesk 用于正文和标签，DM Mono 用于所有铬元素。像素故障垂直扫描线柱和 QR 风格 8×8 马赛克为标志性装饰。像素堆叠条形图以网格单元渲染数据。
bestFor: 设计趋势 / 研究报告
